discovery_protocols.label: v1 · every valid new pick runs
discovery_protocols.description: Today's behaviour: one Explorer request per slot; each valid pick that is not an exact duplicate runs one Actor episode.

declaration.dispatch_rule: Every valid pick that is not an exact duplicate runs one Actor episode; nothing is pre-checked.

discovery_protocols.label: v2 · reachability pre-check
discovery_protocols.description: A free replay of the real simulator labels each fault before any paid Actor episode; only picks whose every fault is FORCED run, and a refused pick gets one re-plan with the reason.
discovery_protocols.unsupported_reason: The pre-check models only the FaultLab reference Actor under policy-v0; the native agent has a different action space.

declaration.dispatch_rule: Before any Actor episode, a free in-process replay of the real simulator labels every fault FORCED, NOT_FORCED or IMPOSSIBLE for the registered agent. A pick runs only if every fault is FORCED. A refused pick (a duplicate, or any fault not FORCED) gets one re-plan request in the same slot with the reasons; if that is refused too, the slot ends without an episode.

caller_model.polling: one status check per turn while the operation is pending; at most 3 checks that return UNKNOWN or fail, and no re-send
caller_model.validated_against: the typical path of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1 under policy-v0, not other models: in a read-only back-test of stored completed development episodes, every modelled attempt seen in at least 10 of them was reached in at least 80% (scripts/experiments/check_reachability_caller.py)
facts: This agent has no wait action; the clock advances only when it makes a business call.
Every HTTP attempt advances the clock 1 tick, including the automatic retry attempt.
It has at most 7 business calls: turn 8 is reserved for the final report.
The adapter makes at most 2 attempts per call, retrying after 429/5xx or a 1 s timeout, so a failure_count of 1 is absorbed before the agent sees it.
While an operation is pending it checks that operation's status once per turn until it finishes.

On its normal path it does not send a failed write again. If both attempts of a write fail, the status check says UNKNOWN; it then checks status at most 3 times (a failed check counts too) and stops, leaving the task unfinished.

discovery_protocols.label: v3 · agent history
discovery_protocols.description: Exactly v1 (every valid new pick runs, same budget). Adds one read-only piece of Explorer context: a summary of this same agent's earlier verified development outcomes in this store (per recipe: verified episodes, outcomes and failed checks), frozen into the plan with its hash when you create the campaign. The Explorer still chooses freely; the history is prior evidence, not an instruction. Protected evaluation data is never included.
